summary: Happy path: confirm the intro over the detected sources, keep any task notice, answer the agent's credential questions from E2E_* env vars, delete installed skills.

variations.name: default
variations.summary: linear / anthropic / sonnet — parity with main

path.auto: scan installDir for warehouse signals — writes detectedWarehouseSources, or a detectError when the project has none
confirm & continue — lists what detection found
keep — only shown on the orchestrator sequence, where the warehouse step is a seeded task the user can decline
(external) — the agent runs the data-warehouse-source-setup skill: it collects credentials through wizard_ask, creates in-cli sources over the PostHog MCP, and emits a deep link for the rest
answer every question in the batch — askAnswers routes each credential field to its E2E_* env var; anything unrouted takes the first option, else the 'e2e' sentinel
delete — leave nothing behind (terminal: the run's done-signal)
